# Agentized

> Agentized helps mid-market companies redesign high-value revenue and operating
> workflows around governed AI agents, then build, integrate and measure the result.
> Founded by Jas Dhillon and Mark Fidelman, authors of the book AGENT SHOCK:
> Surviving and Profiting from the Rise of AI Agents and Robots.

Key facts:
- Engagements begin with a paid Agentic Value Assessment (4–6 weeks, six stages:
  Align, Map, Quantify, Design, Prioritize, Decide).
- The assessment is designed for companies with roughly $25M+ in revenue or a
  comparably complex operating environment, and an executive sponsor.
- Engagement ladder: Agentic Value Assessment → 90-Day Agentic Value Pilot →
  Enterprise Agentization Program → Managed Agentic Operations → Board and CEO Advisory.
- Method: the Agentized Value System — Diagnose, Redesign, Deploy, Prove, Scale.
- Agentized publishes no client testimonials or results until a client approves them.

## Services

- [Agentic AI Consulting](https://www.agentized.com/consulting): The engagement ladder, the Agentized Value System, how value is measured, and an FAQ.
- [Agentic Value Assessment](https://www.agentized.com/assessment): The paid 4–6 week diagnostic: stages, fit criteria, application, and an FAQ.
- [Solutions](https://www.agentized.com/solutions): Agentic revenue systems, operations (margin and capacity) and execution speed.
- [Agentized Command](https://www.agentized.com/platform): Proposed agent governance and value-management layer; pre-product, design-partner stage.
- [Governance](https://www.agentized.com/governance): Authority, access, evaluation, human escalation and audit for agentic AI.
- [Results](https://www.agentized.com/results): How Agentized separates expected value from realized value.

## Book: AGENT SHOCK

- [AGENT SHOCK](https://www.agentized.com/book): Core concepts (the Waterline and the Ladder, the Four Shocks, Agent Passports, AgentShock, gates not dates), contents, authors, and an FAQ.
- [Introduction](https://www.agentized.com/introduction): The book's introduction.
- [Reader Resources](https://www.agentized.com/resources): Companion tools referenced in the book.
